newsitem.title: USA: Washington CFO says job on line over city audit.
newsitem.headline: Washington CFO says job on line over city audit.

text.p: The District of Columbia's chief financial officer, stinging from a critical audit of fiscal 1996 D.C. finances, said that, if he fails to produce a clean audit in the next year, the city should look for another CFO.

"The bottom line is we have to clean up this audit over the next year," Anthony Williams, the city's congressionally mandated CFO, told a news conference following the release of D.C.'s fiscal 1996 audit by KPMG Peat Marwick.
"If we haven't, I think it is fair to say you've got to find a new financial management team."
